title: Connected Components and Shortest Path Introduction Quiz
description: A quick check to review connected components and shortest path basics.

questions.question: What is a connected component?

options.text: A group of nodes connected to each other
A list that must be sorted

questions.explanation: A connected component is a group of nodes where each node can reach other nodes in the same group.

questions.question: Which algorithm is commonly used to find the shortest path distance in an unweighted graph?
questions.explanation: BFS explores nodes level by level, so it can find the shortest path in an unweighted graph.
